'''Imperial Energy Systems''' was a highly productive subdepartment of the [[Ministry of Energy]]. Founded in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], it specialized in producing large-scale portable power generators to help in disaster relief operations. Imperial Energy Systems was [[Director of Imperial Energy Systems/Legends|headed]] by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tiaan Jerjerrod/Legends|Tiaan Jerjerrod]].<ref name="GNN 6">{{JournalCite|6|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Cynabar's InfoNet]] learned that many [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] ships assigned to the Imperial Energy Systems subministry were involved in shipping raw materials to undisclosed locations.<ref name="GNN 7">{{JournalCite|7|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
As Jerjerrod was promoted from [[Logistics and Supply]] to command the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] construction project, it is likely this subministry was actually a cover for that project.<ref name="GG5">[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi'', Second Edition]]</ref>
